posts.title: Lazy weekend poll ~ open thread, latish-November 2026
posts.description: It’s almost Thanksgiving and we’re relaxing before the holiday festivities with our usual open thread poll. Talk about anything you like — the fragrance you’re wearing today, any cooking or travel (or perfume shopping? just curling up with a good book?) plans you might have this week, whatever. Or, ask a question about fragrance, then see if anyone else has asked a question that you can answer…
